title: Fairer Recipes
body:
Fair Recipes Datapack (Minecraft 1.21.4)
Tired of getting only one measly button from a whole plank? This datapack rebalances many of Minecraft’s crafting recipes to make them more fair and logical. You’ll get more output from certain crafts, making resource use feel less wasteful while keeping the game’s progression intact.

Features include:

Increased outputs for low-yield items (e.g., planks → buttons).

Adjusted recipes to better match material cost.

Keeps gameplay survival-friendly and vanilla-compatible.

Works seamlessly in both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds.

Perfect for players who want a more balanced and rewarding crafting experience without overhauling the game.
